articles.summary: Public bus fares in Karnataka have been raised by up to 35% in response to rising operational costs, following a recent increase in milk prices.
articles.explain: BMTC stands for Bengaluru Metropolitan Transport Corporation, which manages the city's bus network. These price hikes are a sign of cost-push inflation, where the rising cost of running a business (fuel, labor, maintenance) is transferred to the final customer.

story.title: Inflationary Pressures in Karnataka
story.so_far: Consumers across India have been navigating persistent inflation, which impacts essential goods like dairy and transportation services. State governments frequently subsidize these costs, but fiscal constraints often force them to pass price increases on to the public.

timeline.text: Commuters in Bengaluru face higher costs as state-run transit agencies hike fares following broader commodity price increases.
timeline.source: Business News Today: Latest Business New

articles.title: Marine heatwaves, shifting fish populations threaten coastal livelihoods, warn scientists
articles.source: Business News Today: Latest Business New
articles.summary: Scientists warn that marine heatwaves are disrupting fish populations, necessitating advanced AI-driven monitoring systems for ecosystem protection.
articles.explain: Marine heatwaves occur when sea surface temperatures are warmer than normal for an extended period. Remote sensing involves using satellites to observe the Earth's surface from space to collect data without direct physical contact.

story.title: Climate Change and Marine Ecosystems
story.so_far: Climate change continues to alter global weather patterns, leading to more frequent and intense marine heatwaves. These phenomena damage coral reefs and force fish species to migrate to cooler waters, which severely impacts the economies of coastal communities relying on traditional fishing.

timeline.text: Researchers are calling for the integration of AI and satellite data to better track shifting marine life as oceans warm.
timeline.source: Business News Today: Latest Business New

articles.title: Govt approves ₹14,500-crore VGF scheme for grid-scale energy storage systems
articles.source: Business News Today: Latest Business New
articles.summary: The Indian government has approved a ₹14,500-crore scheme to support the construction of 92 GWh of grid-scale energy storage capacity.
articles.explain: VGF (Viability Gap Funding) is a government grant provided to make projects that are economically necessary but not initially profitable, financially viable for private investors. GWh (Gigawatt-hour) is a measure of energy storage capacity.

story.title: Grid-Scale Energy Storage Funding
story.so_far: India is aggressively expanding its solar and wind energy production to meet carbon reduction goals. However, these energy sources are intermittent—they only produce power when the sun shines or the wind blows—making storage technologies critical for constant power supply.

timeline.text: Government policy is shifting to prioritize large-scale storage as a means to stabilize the power grid during the renewable energy transition.
timeline.source: Business News Today: Latest Business New

articles.title: Keralam resolution to guide PACs of Parliament, States Legislatures to function more efficiently
articles.source: Business News Today: Latest Business New
articles.summary: The Lok Sabha Speaker stated that the Public Accounts Committee (PAC) must focus on monitoring the Executive's implementation of policy to ensure accountability.
articles.explain: The Executive branch of government is responsible for implementing laws passed by the Legislature. The Public Accounts Committee is a parliamentary committee that reviews government expenditure to ensure taxpayer money is spent as authorized by the legislature.

story.title: Legislative Accountability Reform
story.so_far: In a democratic system, the legislature's role is to create laws and hold the executive (the government) accountable for its actions and budget spending. PACs are key committees responsible for reviewing the government's audit reports.

timeline.text: A new Keralam resolution is intended to harmonize and improve the oversight functions of Parliamentary committees across Indian states.

articles.title: M K Sons Fine Jewels stock declines 5% from listing price
articles.source: Business News Today: Latest Business New
articles.summary: Shares of M K Sons Fine Jewels fell by 5% following their debut on the National Stock Exchange, despite an initial premium at listing.
articles.explain: The NSE is the National Stock Exchange of India. A 'premium' listing means the stock opened at a price higher than what investors paid during the pre-market offering (issue price). A decline following the debut indicates investors selling off shares shortly after buying.

story.title: M K Sons Market Debut

articles.source: mint - markets
articles.summary: MCX shares fell 7% due to profit-booking despite the company reporting that its Q2 net profit more than doubled to ₹455 crore.
articles.explain: Profit-booking is a market term where investors sell shares that have increased in value to 'lock in' their gains. articles.title: CFTC clears stock perpetual futures for trading on US exchanges
articles.source: Cointelegraph.com News
articles.summary: US regulators have approved the introduction of stock-based perpetual futures, a trading mechanism common in cryptocurrency markets.
articles.explain: Perpetual futures are essentially bets on the future price of an asset that never expire. They are different from standard futures, which have a set date where the contract must be settled or rolled over. This approval represents a major convergence between crypto-native trading styles and traditional Wall Street financial products.

story.title: Introduction of Stock Perpetual Futures
story.so_far: Perpetual futures are a derivative product that allows traders to hold a position indefinitely without an expiration date, using funding rates to keep the asset price aligned with its underlying value. Traditionally popular in volatile crypto markets, these products are now being integrated into the traditional US stock market framework under federal oversight.

timeline.text: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) has cleared stock-based perpetual futures for trading on US exchanges.
timeline.source: Cointelegraph.com News

timeline.text: The regulatory body has completed the clearance process, allowing these perpetual products to be traded on institutional exchanges.
timeline.source: CoinDesk: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Crypto News
